title: Raking Up Old Scores
next_chapter_hook: On that list, the first name made Chen Ji's pupils constrict—that was the true name of the first Observer, which even Mo Xiansheng had never mentioned.

text.content: That cold voice echoed through the Council Hall, like a serpent's tongue crawling out from the abyss, carrying a chill that corroded all living things. 'Waste, you think by clinging to a few lives you can escape your destined chess game?' The voice paused, then turned sharply harsher, 'Or have you forgotten—the death sentence from Chapter 476 was never rescinded?' Su Qingyao's face turned ghastly pale instantly, that number like a sharp blade stabbing into her heart—that was Chen Ji's life-and-death turning point, the nightmare she could never bear to mention.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, his eyes showing no trace of fear, instead revealing a hint of amused smile. He raised his hand, the Tianji Record Fragment appearing in his palm, golden patterns flowing like living creatures. 'The old score from Chapter 476,' his voice terrifyingly calm, 'I should indeed settle with you properly.' Before the words finished, the fragment suddenly burst with dazzling golden light, an aura powerful enough to distort time and space instantly locking onto the direction of the voice's source.

text.content: The golden light tore open a rift in the void, revealing what lay beyond—a dark underground altar, with a black-robed figure standing at its center, their robe embroidered with twisted runes. And around the altar, densely packed points of light flickered to life, unmistakably a network covering the entire capital and extending to the three major sects! Each point of light was a hidden agent, each connecting line a bloodstained chain of interests.

dialogue.content: The black-robed figure—the Arbiter of Settlements—let out a mocking laugh. 'Mere trickery! You think with this incomplete Tianji Record, you can see the whole picture?' He waved his sleeve, and that network diagram began to violently tremble, as if trying to break free from Chen Ji's control. 'Naive! Against absolute power, any scheme is a joke!' As his words fell, a terrifying pressure surged from the depths of the altar, rushing directly toward Chen Ji.

text.content: Chen Ji didn't budge at all, his smile at the corner of his lips even deepening. He softly said: 'Absolute power?' With a flick of his fingertip, the network diagram suddenly stabilized, and then names began to emerge from the points of light one after another—the Vice Minister of Revenue, the Outer Sect Elder of Xuanwu Sect, the keeper of the Tianqing Sect's scripture library... even a name that made everyone present gasp: Han Lie.

dialogue.content: Almost at the same moment, a furious roar came from the direction of Xuanwu Sect. 'Bullshit!' Han Lie's phantom suddenly condensed above the Council Hall, his qi and blood surging like boiling water. 'Chen Ji! You slanderer! How could I, the number one prodigy of Xuanwu, associate with such insignificant clowns!' His eyes burned with fury, but when his gaze met Chen Ji's calm eyes like an abyss, he inexplicably felt a chill.

text.content: Chen Ji didn't even look at him, just speaking calmly: 'Han Lie, Xuanwu Sect prodigy, unparalleled combat power, yet repeatedly defeated by this 'waste' of mine.' His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears. 'Three years ago, the merchant caravan you secretly supported was destroyed in the capital, losing three million spirit stones; two years ago, your informants planted in Tianqing Sect were uprooted; half a year ago, your secret agreement with the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path was intercepted—' He paused. 'Did these 'clowns' ever get reimbursed for cleaning up your messes?'

dialogue.content: Han Lie's face instantly flushed red, that was the embarrassment and mortification of being exposed. 'You... you lie!' His voice began to tremble, having lost all his previous confidence. 'These are all coincidences! I and the Old Heavenly Dao...' Halfway through, he suddenly realized something, his pupils constricted—he had personally admitted the words 'Old Heavenly Dao.'

text.content: The entire hall erupted in chaos. Those sect elders and family heads who had been half-doubtful now looked at Han Lie with changed eyes—from reverence to scrutiny and wariness. The number one talent of Xuanwu Sect actually had connections with the remnants of the Old Heavenly Dao? What that meant, everyone present knew well. Chen Ji's lips curved into a cold smile, just about to begin his settlement, when a hoarse yet vigorous voice suddenly came from outside the hall—'Chen Ji, could you do this old man a favor?'

dialogue.content: The hall door opened by itself with no wind. Ling Yuan's figure appeared before everyone's eyes like a ghost. This old patriarch of Tianqing Sect had white hair and beard, but his murky old eyes concealed sharp light, and when sweeping across the hall, carried an imposing pressure that needed no anger to command. He slowly walked to Chen Ji and actually bowed slightly. 'This old man heard someone was doing evil in the name of the Old Heavenly Dao, so I came to offer a... small gift.' With that, he took out a yellowed bamboo slip from his sleeve. 'The complete roster of the Old Heavenly Dao Guardians Alliance, including the identities of all past Arbiters.'

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan suddenly appeared to offer the roster—what is this old fox planning?

choices.description: Since Ling Yuan dares to offer gifts publicly, he must have backing. Rather than refusing and being sabotaged by him behind the scenes, better to see what he's scheming.
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan was the previous generation's candidate for Chen Xuan's legacy, harboring schemes in his heart

dialogue.content: A barely perceptible glint of satisfaction flickered in Ling Yuan's eyes as he handed over the bamboo slip with both hands. 'Young Friend Chen has great courage. This old man has waited for this day far too long.' His voice was low and profound. 'Every name on this roster, this old man witnessed their crimes—including the true name of the first Observer.'

text.content: The moment Chen Ji took the bamboo slip, a faint spiritual fluctuation transmitted through his fingertips—that was Ling Yuan's probe. His expression unchanged, he gently flicked his fingertip, silently dissolving that spiritual power. 'I appreciate Patriarch Ling's kindness.' His voice was calm, but a cold light flickered in his eyes—this old thing, truly has ulterior motives.

choices.description: Ling Yuan is a candidate for the hidden big boss, cooperating with him is no different than making a pact with the tiger. Publicly expose his hypocrisy, let everyone see his true colors.
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's strength is unfathomable, the risk of direct confrontation is extremely high

dialogue.content: Chen Ji didn't reach out, just looked at Ling Yuan with a knowing smile. 'I appreciate Patriarch Ling's kindness—but I never dance with wolves.' His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly spread through the entire Council Hall. 'Does everyone know that this 'highly respected' old patriarch was once a candidate for inheriting the Tianji Record? After being completely overshadowed by Senior Chen Xuan's brilliance, his resentment runs deeper than anyone's!'

text.content: Ling Yuan's expression instantly darkened, the murky old eyes flashing sharp light. That long-brewing pressure surged forth like a tide, yet was blocked by an invisible barrier the moment it touched Chen Ji. He coldly said: 'Chen Ji, do you truly believe that with that incomplete Tianji Record, you can oppose this old man?' The temperature in the Council Hall suddenly dropped, everyone feeling that suffocating oppressive force.

choices.description: Neither refuse nor accept, publicly expose Ling Yuan's connection to the Arbiter, putting him in an impossible position.
choices.visible_reward: Isolate Ling Yuan on the spot
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may act desperately in desperation

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, his laughter particularly harsh in the silent Council Hall. He didn't take the bamboo slip, instead raising the Tianji Record Fragment, golden light blooming again. 'Patriarch Ling, you just said this roster includes past Arbiters?' His gaze was like a blade. 'Then tell me—what is the relationship between the 32nd Arbiter and you?' As the words fell, the network diagram suddenly shifted, one point of light pointing directly at Ling Yuan.

text.content: Ling Yuan's expression slightly changed, then returned to calm. 'I don't know what you're talking about.' But his voice had already lost its previous composure. More importantly, the gazes of others in the Council Hall had shifted from reverence to suspicion and wariness. Chen Ji softly said: 'Don't know? No problem. The Tianji Record will help Patriarch Ling... remember.'

Just then, that cold voice from the altar rang out again, this time with obvious mockery: 'Ling Yuan, do you think surrendering will save your life?' The Arbiter's laughter echoed in the void. 'The master has long seen through your little tricks—the 32nd Arbiter was merely a chess piece the master casually discarded. And you are merely a more pitiful speck of dust on an even larger chessboard!' Ling Yuan's expression instantly turned ashen, he suddenly looked at Chen Ji, his emotions complex and hard to decipher.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji!' Ling Yuan's voice suddenly rose, a resolute look appearing on his aged face. 'This old man is willing to cooperate with you! That roster, I can give it to you right now!' He abruptly tossed the bamboo slip toward Chen Ji. 'But this old man has only one condition—kill that Arbiter who betrayed me!' His eyes burned with intense hatred. 'He knows too much, he must die!'

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan and the Arbiter have completely broken apart, how to exploit this variable?

choices.description: Since Ling Yuan has turned against the Arbiter, we might as well use him to weaken the Old Heavenly Dao's forces. Kill two birds with one stone, let them destroy each other.
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may turn on you at any moment

dialogue.content: Chen Ji caught the bamboo slip, his lips curving into a meaningful arc. 'Patriarch Ling is indeed straightforward.' He tucked the slip into his sleeve, his gaze never leaving the network diagram in the void. 'However, I have one more condition—you must tell everyone, how you were selected by the Tianji Record, and how you were eliminated.'

text.content: Ling Yuan's body abruptly stiffened, a flash of humiliation and anger crossing his aged face. But for only an instant, he regained his composure, softly saying: 'Very well.' This word squeezed through his teeth, carrying endless hatred. He began to recount—the selection thirty years ago, why the Tianji Record chose Chen Xuan instead of him, how he stepped into the abyss step by step in hatred...

choices.description: Ling Yuan, the Arbiter, Han Lie—leave no one off. Expose all the scandals of the Old Heavenly Dao remnants to the public, leaving them nowhere to hide.
choices.risk_hint: May provoke all forces to unite in counterattack

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly burst out laughing, his laughter echoing through the Council Hall. 'Patriarch Ling, you think transferring your hatred to the Arbiter can cleanse your crimes?' He raised his hand, the Tianji Record Fragment bursting with dazzling golden light. 'Everyone, please look—' In the golden light, scenes emerged: how Ling Yuan colluded with the Arbiter, how he betrayed Tianqing Sect's secrets, how he schemed secretly for decades... each detail was shocking.

text.content: Ling Yuan's expression instantly turned deathly pale, he abruptly stepped back, his terror in his eyes no longer concealable. 'You... how could you possibly...' His voice trembled. 'Those things, this old man did extremely covertly, how could a servant disciple like you...' Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, calmly saying: 'Because I am the inheritor of the Tianji Record. And you are merely a clown it saw through long ago.'

Just then, a thunderous roar suddenly echoed from the void. 'Enough!' The Arbiter's voice exploded like thunder, an unprecedented pressure surging from the depths of the altar, rushing directly toward the Council Hall. 'Chen Ji, do you think these petty tricks can overturn the heavens?' His voice carried boundless fury and disbelief. 'The master's chess game waited ten thousand years—how can an ant like you destroy it! Since you insist on seeking death—let the entire Tianqing Sect be buried with you!'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji didn't budge at all, his smile at the corner of his lips even deepening. He softly said: 'Buried?' With a flick of his fingertip, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly burst with dazzling golden light, that terrifying pressure was actually frozen in an instant, like an eagle having its wings clutched by an invisible hand. 'You think I showed you that network diagram to threaten you?' His voice was terrifyingly calm. 'That was the Tianji Record calculating—calculating how much it would cost to utterly destroy you.'

text.content: Under the radiance of golden light, that network diagram began to frantically shrink, countless points of light extinguishing one after another. Each extinguished point represented a hidden agent the Arbiter had placed, a chain of interests, a chess piece—under Chen Ji's power of fate writing, all turned to nothing. 'Three years ago, the seventy-two hidden agents you planted in Tianqing Sect, I have already uprooted sixty-nine.' Chen Ji's voice was like a verdict. 'Two years ago, your plan to infiltrate the three major sects, I have completely shattered. Half a year ago, the evidence of your secret agreement with Han Lie, I have submitted to the Sect Master of Xuanwu.'

dialogue.content: The Arbiter's voice trembled for the first time. 'How... how could you have done all this! You are merely a waste! An ant abandoned by the heavens!' His voice carried disbelief and terror. 'The master's layout was flawless, the master schemed for ten thousand years, and you, a mere mortal...' Chen Ji interrupted him, calmly saying: 'Because your master made one mistake—it shouldn't have let the Tianji Record inheritor survive until now.'

text.content: The golden light exploded violently, that network diagram completely collapsed, countless points of light turning into shooting stars dissipating into the void. The Arbiter's figure violently distorted in the golden light, letting out agonized screams. However, just then, Chen Ji suddenly felt a sharp pain—that was the warning of his Heavenly Fate rapidly depleting. His expression slightly changed, yet he forcibly maintained the golden light. 'Senior Chen Xuan's backup, as expected, wasn't easy to use.' He murmured. 'But killing you, is enough.'

The golden light dissipated, the void returned to calm. The Arbiter's figure had completely vanished, leaving only a void of darkness. But everyone knew this was only a temporary victory—the true power of the Heavenly Eye was far from fully displayed. And at this moment, Chen Ji slowly unfolded the bamboo slip Ling Yuan had offered, his gaze sweeping across the names on it. Suddenly, his movement stopped, his entire body struck like thunder, staring fixedly at the first line on the bamboo slip. Ling Yuan approached, softly saying: 'The first Observer's true name... does Young Friend Chen recognize it?' Chen Ji didn't answer, only slowly raised his head, his eyes flickering with complex light—shock, anger, and a trace of indefinable... sorrow.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's voice sounded beside him, carrying a flavor between gloating and genuine warning: 'Young Friend Chen, the first Observer's true name... are you truly going to speak it out?' His gaze was profound. 'Once spoken, there is no turning back. The Heavenly Eye... will sense it.' His words seemed to contain some kind of warning, and also some kind of anticipation.

text.content: The Council Hall was utterly silent. Everyone held their breath, waiting for Chen Ji's decision. Su Qingyao sensed the change in Chen Ji's aura, an ominous premonition rising in her heart—she had never seen Chen Ji so shaken, even facing life and death, he could maintain that从容冷笑. But at this moment, the hand holding the bamboo slip was actually trembling slightly. Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, deeply inhaling. When he opened his eyes again, those eyes had recovered their usual calm, only with some kind of resolve hidden deep within. 'This name...' his voice was low and firm, 'I have recorded it.
